title: Naval Intelligence as a major funder of Puharich
summary: Greg tells of Naval Intelligence as a major funder of Puharich, about 1950s–early 1980s at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: cuz we know we know Naval Intelligence at one point uh was like a big funder of Puharich, not not only back in the '50s, but going into um the early '80s as well.

plain: A researcher named Greg says that Naval Intelligence, the US Navy's spy service, was at one point a big funder of Andrija Puharich, a man whose work is the subject of the episode. Greg says this funding ran from the 1950s into the early 1980s. He tells it on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, since it would tie the Navy to Puharich's work over decades.
